mapper.select: SELECT r.*, p.name AS patient_name, d.name AS doctor_name, dept.name AS department_name FROM registration r JOIN patient p ON r.patient_id = p.id JOIN doctor d ON r.doctor_id = d.id JOIN department dept ON r.department_id = dept.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO registration (patient_id, doctor_id, department_id, register_time, status, created_by) VALUES (#{patientId}, #{doctorId}, #{departmentId}, #{registerTime}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
